title: 처음 만났어요: 자기소개 낱말
objective: By the end, you can use basic words to say your name, your country, your job and where you live when you meet someone for the first time.
summary: Ten basic words for introducing yourself when you meet someone for the first time in Korea.

task.title: USE THE NEW WORDS
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write or complete the Korean word that fits.

words.meaning: I (polite way to talk about yourself)
person; after a country name, a person from that country

words.exampleMeaning: Nice to meet you. (said only the first time you meet someone)
There are ten students in our class.
My father works in an office.
What do you do for a living?

exercises: Choose the right word: ①저는 인도 (사람이에요 / 나라예요). ②러시아는 아주 큰 (사람이에요 / 나라예요).
Fill in the blank with a word from this worksheet: ①A: ____이 뭐예요? B: 의사예요. ②A: 고양이 ____이 뭐예요? B: 나비예요.
Fill in the blank with the polite -아요 form of 'to live': 저는 지금 제주도에 ____.
Read and answer in Korean. Is he 학생 or 회사원?: 저는 대학교에 다녀요. 회사에 안 다녀요.
Fill in the blank (for the first time): 저는 오늘 김치를 ____ 먹어요.
Fill in the blank with the polite -습니다 form of 반갑다: 아, 지민 씨! 다시 만나서 ____.
